dedupe_keys.name: waihi mine tailings storage facility digital twin pilot oceanagold

description: A pilot digital twin of the tailings storage facility at OceanaGold's Waihi gold mine in New Zealand. The sponsored Geoengineer.org article of 23 February 2024 says the pilot, led by Andre Alipate, linked Seequent Central, Leapfrog Geo and GeoStudio with Bentley iTwin IoT in a cloud environment, so that geological and geotechnical models sit alongside live instrument data. It describes monitoring sensor readings such as core pore pressure and groundwater after rainfall and automated reporting to engineers. The article is free to read online. Coverage is one tailings facility at Waihi. Caveats: the article is sponsored content and gives no performance numbers; the page states all rights reserved for the article text. For simulation it shows how a tailings dam twin can combine rainfall response with stability models, a pattern for early warning of dam failure. A related catalogue record is the Seequent tailings management solution.
